title: Use of Surface Electromyography Biofeedback to Improve Reaching in Children With Cerebral Palsy
brief_summary: A newly-developed device for biofeedback of surface EMG will be used to either increase or decrease activity in the muscles of children with poor reaching due to cerebral palsy.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* weakness, hypertonia, or hyperkinetic disorder affecting one or both arms
* reduced speed or quality of reaching

Exclusion Criteria:

* any condition that would increase the risk of participation
study_population: Children with movement disorders, cerebral palsy.
